highlights: Yesido KB44 Wired Keyboard - 104 Keys RGB Backlit Low-Noise Keyboard - English Layout - QWERTY

Enhance your typing experience with the YESIDO KB44 wired mechanical keyboard, a stylish and durable full-size keyboard that blends quiet performance with vibrant RGB backlighting. Designed for comfort, longevity, and compatibility, it’s ideal for work, study, and gaming alike.
Low-Noise Operation - Engineered for quiet typing to maintain a peaceful workspace, with a lifespan of up to 2 years of daily use.
Mechanical-Style Keycaps - Original-height keycaps mimic the feel and precision of a mechanical keyboard while keeping the sound level low.
RGB Backlighting Effects - Features mixed color lighting with gap illumination and adjustable brightness levels, including breathing light effects for a visually dynamic setup.
Tri-Color Gradient Keycaps - Stylish side-etched design available in flat or spherical profiles, offering a modern, premium appearance.
18 FN Shortcut Keys - Boost productivity with 18 multifunctional FN combinations for quick access to system and media controls.
Broad Compatibility - Works seamlessly with Windows 95 / 98 / ME / NT / XP / 7 / 8 / 10, making it suitable for a wide range of devices.
Plug & Play USB Connection - Simple wired setup ensures stable performance with zero input lag.
